entries.name: Eyes of the Spirit World (Hermit charm)
entries.effect: When activated (1 SPI), reveals if you are being divined right now. One charge per use.

entries.name: Blank Paper Talisman (Fool pathway)
entries.effect: Affix to a surface: the room cannot be divined for 1 hour. One-time use.

entries.name: Mystical Candle of Obscurity
entries.effect: Burning during a ritual suppresses detection of that ritual by -3 to anyone sensing it. Lasts 1 hour.

entries.name: Silver Mirror of Reflection
entries.effect: When placed on an altar, any divination targeting the owner has a 50% chance (1–3 on 1d6) of reflecting back on the diviner.

entries.name: Salt of Spiritual Clarity
entries.effect: A pinch thrown into the air purifies the spiritual environment. Any active divination targeting the area is interrupted and must restart.
